text:
tara: Hey — quick approval question. I have a small refactor PR touching libs/runtime/session_cache.py but CODEOWNERS doesn't list an owner for libs/runtime/. Who can approve so I can merge? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/12345
kevin: which path exactly?
tara: libs/runtime/session_cache.py and tests under tests/runtime/. Current CODEOWNERS has entries for /runtime/* and /infra/* but not /libs/runtime. snippet:
```
# CODEOWNERS
/docs/ @docs-team
/runtime/ @eng-runtime
/infra/ @eng-platform
```
maria: :eyes: hmm looks like the repo has a couple of different conventions. I think /runtime/ is for the monorepo runtime service, not the libs/ package. cc @sam from eng-platform
alex: I can review the code changes (I'm on eng-runtime), but per our approval rules infra-touching things need an eng-platform owner too. Does this PR change any deploy config or k8s annotations?
tara: no infra or deploy changes, just refactor + a tiny perf tweak in caching logic. added PR description + risk/rollback notes. I also initially tried adding a CODEOWNERS line for /libs/runtime/ @eng-runtime but rolled that back (will open separate owners PR if needed).
kevin: +1 on separate PR for owners — don't mix ownership changes with functional changes. If this is only code-level and tests, eng-runtime review + eng-platform approval ok.
sam: If there's no infra impact I'm fine signing off from eng-platform. Can you add a one-line rollout plan and call out that feature flags aren't involved? I'll give the formal approval then.
tara: done — added rollout plan: "deploy on next canary, monitor session cache hit ratio, revert within 30m if errors > 1%". also clarified no feature flags.
maria: can you paste the small perf benchmark line you mentioned in the PR thread? helps reviewers.
tara: pasted: `cache hit ratio +2.3% on microbench for local workload`
codeowners-bot: Note: repository CODEOWNERS currently does not have an explicit entry for /libs/runtime/ — consider separate PR to add @eng-runtime
alex: I reviewed the change, tests look good. no infra touch.
sam: reviewed the PR description + rollout. approving now.
deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #12345 (all checks green)
sam: :white_check_mark: Approved. Merge after green CI and then watch metrics for 30m.
tara: thanks all! merging after CI finishes. will follow up in #releases if anything odd shows up!
